scope: Initial publication metadata review of one exact corroboration statement in the fluorite source dossier. Not a native scientific record review or a final whole-packet audit.

findings.claim: Crossref and the publisher API independently match title, authors, DOI and March 1984 publication.
findings.evidence: The pinned Elsevier API XML contains coredata title, DOI, journal and publication date, but no author element or author value. Crossref independently contains the two authors.
findings.impact: The discovery report overstates which bibliographic fields were independently corroborated by the publisher API. This does not challenge the article identity or the scientific record.
findings.required_correction: Attribute author verification to Crossref and the original scan; state that the Elsevier API corroborates title, DOI, journal and publication date only. Refresh the source manifest report hash. Preserve this initial review and use a timestamped successor disposition.

unresolved_questions: Author attribution in the API corroboration statement must be corrected. Final source packet, scientific review and gate receipts remain outside this initial disposition.
limitations: No remote mutation or new live acquisition was performed. This finding uses the retained raw publisher XML and Crossref response.
Other source dossiers and record changes are not given a final publication verdict by this initial artifact.
